Clearance and ground checks pass; 43,730 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The chest reads more purple than the mockup's grey-violet.
The resting sword tip sits close to the ground in the front view.
dark-knight.next: Optional: desaturate the wing panels one step; raise the rest grip a few degrees.

wight.summary: Elf-like wight king on the vampire base: rusted iron crown over white shoulder-length locks, large navy eyes with a pale ring and glints, pointed ears, dark leather armor with a chest strap and rust bracers, tattered cape, rusted sword. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The eyes match the mockup: navy iris, pale sclera ring, black pupil, two glints.
Hair is seven shoulder-length locks; the cape and armor show below it in the back view.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 48,380 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The hair top under the crown still reads as a smooth white dome in the side sprites.
The breastplate lacks embossed relief; the face has less brow and cheek sculpt than the mockup.
wight.next: Optional: break the hair dome with two or three raised locks; add an embossed plate line.

revenant.summary: Undead soldier on the zombie-soldier base: cracked iron helm with a nasal spade, brow rim, cheek flaps and a red plume; mismatched eyes (black pit, orange with a pupil) in dark sockets; stitched grin; pointed ears; crossed leather straps over a tattered teal-grey tunic; rusted axe and round shield. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The mismatched eyes, plume, cracked helm and shield read at 128 px.
Silhouette and colors match the mockup in all four views.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 49,284 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The plume is three spikes rather than the mockup's curled stub.
The shoulder leather caps hide under the pauldrons; the bracer is a plain cone.
revenant.next: Optional: curl the plume with a chain; wrap the bracer with two strap rings.

orc-warlord.summary: Orc chieftain on the orc-warrior base: horned iron helm with a red crest, yellow eyes in dark sockets, jaw tusks, red-brown beard, huge spiked riveted pauldrons with fur trim, chest harness, studded belt and hand-print tabard, tall iron boots with skull bosses, a broad double-headed axe held across the body. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The horns, crest, pauldrons and double axe give the mockup's silhouette in every sprite direction.
Lit rims and rivets keep the iron from reading as flat black at 128 px.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 68,024 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The skin still renders one step brighter than the mockup.
The beard hides the chest harness; the red hand print sits behind the axe haft in the front view.
orc-warlord.next: Optional: darken the skin one more step; shorten the beard so the harness emblem shows.

bandit-captain.summary: Outlaw leader on the bandit base: wide flat-brim hat with a red feather, red bandana, eyepatch, full beard with a curled mustache, red neckerchief, long flared black coat with lapels and brass buttons over a brown vest and buckled belt, hooked cutlass and dagger. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The hat, feather, coat and cutlass read in every sprite direction.
The beard and mustache now separate; the bandana shows under the brim.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 50,732 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The coat folds read weakly because the lit tones sit close to the base color.
The hat brim hides the face in the top-down sprite angle.
bandit-captain.next: Optional: lighten the lapel and cuff tones one step; tilt the hat brim up at the front by a few degrees.

iron-golem.summary: Blocky riveted iron construct on the stone-golem rig: chamfered plates, a small faceted head with a glowing visor slit and a rust spike, a rusty riveted furnace hatch, bent arms with chamfered knuckle fists, box legs with vents and three-toed feet, rust streaks from every rivet. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The boxy silhouette, rivets and rust read in every sprite direction.
The iron value now separates from the shadows at 128 px.
Ground check passes; 24,562 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The visor glow renders pale peach rather than saturated orange at sprite size.
The legs are shorter and more upright than the mockup's tapered blocks.
iron-golem.next: Optional: darken the visor base so the emissive core stays orange; lengthen the shins by 0.03 m.

gargoyle.summary: Crouching winged stone demon on the imp rig: ridged horns, a spine crest, angry yellow eyes under heavy brows, a fanged grin, carved chest and belly bands, big bat wings with thick rims and elbow claws, a spade-tipped tail, dark grey stone with moss stains. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The spread wings, horns, yellow eyes and grin read in every sprite direction.
The stone value separates from the shadows at 128 px.
Ground check passes; 40,678 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The wing membranes are flat panels without the mockup's carved relief.
The tail is half hidden by the leg in the front sprite.
gargoyle.next: Optional: add two curved membrane ridges per wing in bump; raise the tail 0.05 m.

banshee.summary: Screaming banshee: a gaunt grey-green face with glowing cyan eyes and a wide toothed scream, a white mane of thirty hooked locks that stream up and back, a wrapped collar over a folded gown with cyan drips, and four broad twisting ribbon wisps with a cyan core that reach the ground. Reviewed 8.0 after two builds, two feedback passes, and two fresh reworks (Sonnet 5.5 high tier).
strengths: The white mane, the glowing face, the gown, and the cyan ribbons read at 128 px in all eight directions.
The head is one third of the body and the scream reads.
Ground ok, 55,154 triangles, no warnings, no held items.
issues: The locks are thick tubes; the mockup strands are thinner and more flame-like.
The face is smoother than the mockup's gaunt skull.
The ribbons are still band-like next to the mockup's sheets.
banshee.next: Thin the lock tips to r 0.003, add cheek hollows, and widen the ribbons to 0.14 m at the hem.

specter.summary: Floating hooded phantom on the wraith base: a deep peaked hood over a black void face with two glowing green eyes, layered scarf bands, a grey-blue robe with a torn front panel and hem, dark bony arms with clawed hands and wrist chains, curling green mist at the hem. Reviewed 8.0 after three passes (one feedback pass, one fresh rework).
strengths: The hood, green eyes and mist read in every sprite direction.
The cloth reads as smooth matte clay in the textured build.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 45,884 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The cowl is a smooth stacked collar rather than crumpled scarf folds.
The robe is a wide cylinder; the mockup tapers to a narrower hem.
specter.next: Optional: displace the top scarf band with a low-frequency fold; taper the robe profile by 0.03 at the hem.

poltergeist.summary: Grinning pale violet ghost on the ghost base: a wide egg head with big glossy black eyes under mischievous brows, a huge square-toothed grin, thumbs-up fists, a short scalloped sheet body, and four orbiting objects (stool, plate, candlestick, book) on their own bones that circle in every clip. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The eyes and grin read at 128 px in the front directions.
The orbiting objects give a unique silhouette in every direction.
Ground check passes; 27,596 triangles, no warnings; no held items.
issues: The grin corners do not curl up like the mockup's.
The stool and candle sit close together in some directions.
poltergeist.next: Optional: curve the mouth cut upward at the corners; spread the orbit offsets evenly at 90 degrees.

vampire-lord.summary: Regal armored vampire on the vampire base: slicked black hair with a widow's peak, pale grey skin, heavy brows, red glowing eyes, a fanged grimace, a red-lined high collar, a black cloak with a bat-wing hem, a gold-trimmed black breastplate with pauldrons, a gold-buckled belt, black boots, clawed hands. Reviewed 8.0 on the first build.
strengths: The collar, hair peak, red eyes and cloak hem read in every sprite direction.
The silhouette and colors match the mockup in all four views.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 41,674 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The eyes render pink rather than deep red because the emissive washes the base.
The gold trim is thinner than the mockup's ornate bat crest.
vampire-lord.next: Optional: darken the eye base to #8a0a0a under the emissive; add a bat-crest emblem outline to the chest.

troll-guard.summary: Hunched troll on the orc-warrior base: a big warty nose, small blue eyes under a heavy brow, an underbite with fat curved tusks, long pointed ears, a shaggy rope mane to the belly, a small cross-hatched riveted iron helmet, a patched torn kilt with a rope belt, and a banded studded club over the right shoulder. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The tusks, helmet, mane and club read in every sprite direction.
The face matches the mockup's expression: brow, nose, underbite.
Clearance and ground checks pass; 64,732 triangles, no warnings.
issues: The skin renders one step greener than the mockup's muted clay.
The club head is smaller than the mockup's flared drum head.
troll-guard.next: Optional: shift the skin toward #7a8a66; widen the club head to r 0.11.

clay-golem.summary: Stocky terracotta construct on the stone-golem rig: a rounded head with hollow eyes, a slot mouth and an amber forehead gem in a rim, big pressed-clay shoulders, a carved rune word on the chest and a shield panel on the belly, short thick arms with blocky hands, thick legs with knee pads and wide three-toed feet, pressed seams and cracks. Reviewed 8.0 after one feedback pass.
strengths: The silhouette matches the mockup in every sprite direction.
The carved rune and shield read at 128 px.

Mockup docs/monster-mockups/drake_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The wingless outline and the stripes set it apart from the fire dragon.
Seven clips (idle, walk, run, attack, hit, death, roar) without the fly clip.

It shares the body, the face, the rig, and the clips of the fire dragon (8.5) through assets/parts/dragon-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for dragon-fire, -ice, -storm); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup drake is lean with a long neck; this is the fire dragon's chunky body.
The horns are pale; the mockup has small ear-like horns.
next: Add a body-length option to the dragon kind for lean dragons (drake, lindworm).

dragon-ancient.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/dragon/dragon-ancient) on the dragon kind. An old dragon: dark bronze-green scales, a pale gold belly, long brown horns that sweep back and out (the new horn option), a white mane (the crest) and bushy white brows, a spiky white beard rigid on the jaw (it opens with the mouth), dull olive wings, gold eyes. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/dragon-ancient_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The beard, the white mane and brows, and the long horns read as old at 128 px.
The beard rides the jaw, so it moves with the roar and the bite.

It shares the body, the face, the rig, and the clips of the fire dragon (8.5) through assets/parts/dragon-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for dragon-fire, -ice, -storm); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup wings are small and tattered; these are the full fire dragon wings in olive.
next: Add a tattered wing outline option to the dragon kind.

hippogriff.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/hippogriff) on the griffin copy. A copy of the griffin with the back half of a horse: a chestnut coat, hind legs that end in near-black hooves (with a hoof sole for the ground plant), a long dark horse tail that hangs from the rump (a shade of the wings slot; it trails back in the air and falls back in the death), yellow eagle front legs with talons. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/hippogriff_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The chestnut body, the hooves, and the horse tail set it apart from the griffin at 128 px.
It keeps the griffin's joints and clips, so it can replace the griffin as a mount.
It keeps the griffin's rig and eight clips (griffin 7.7); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup wings are all brown; these keep the cream flight feathers.
The body keeps the griffin's chibi proportions; the mockup horse body is longer.
next: Add it as a mount option in the griffin games.

giant-boar.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/giant-boar) on the boar kind. The boar without horns: dark brown fur, big ivory tusks (1.5 times as long), a tall black mane (1.6 times as high), a pink snout, red eyes; the ivory slot is named tusks. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-boar_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The tall black mane and the big tusks match the mockup and read at 128 px.
It is the plain kind of the horned boar, which was built as this row's horned variant.
It shares the body, the head, the rig, and the seven horned boar clips through assets/parts/boar-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for horned-boar); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup has bristle tufts on the flanks; the body here is smooth.
next: Add a few dark bristle tufts on the flanks.

unicorn.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/fey-and-spirit/unicorn) on the horse kind. A white horse with a rainbow mane and tail, a gold spiral horn on the head bone, gold hooves, and violet eyes; no halter, blaze, or socks. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/unicorn_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The gold horn and the rainbow mane read at 128 px from the front and the side.
It shares the body, the head, the rig, and the horse clips through assets/parts/horse-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for horse); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The rainbow bands of the mane are soft, so the colors blend at their edges.
next: Make the mane bands a little sharper.

nightmare.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/fey-and-spirit/nightmare) on the horse kind. A black horse with glowing red eyes, a glowing violet fire mane and tail with pale violet tips, and orange flame rings around the hooves (skinned to the shins). Mockup docs/monster-mockups/nightmare_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The red eyes and the violet fire mane read on the black body at 128 px.
It shares the body, the rig, and the horse clips through assets/parts/horse-kind.ts; the hoof flames start above the ground (the rest pose was 2 cm low before the fix); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The hoof flames are short and orange, and the mockup flames are taller.
next: Make the hoof flames taller and give them a yellow core.

kelpie.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/fey-and-spirit/kelpie) on the horse kind. A teal water horse with a dark green seaweed mane and tail, scale paint on the legs, cheek fins, and leg fins. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/kelpie_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The teal coat, the seaweed mane, and the leg scales read as a water horse.
It shares the body, the rig, and the horse clips through assets/parts/horse-kind.ts; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The fins are small and show mainly in the side view.
next: Make the cheek fins larger, so they show in the front view.

shadow-hound.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/abyssal-and-cosmic/shadow-hound) on the wolf kind. A black wolf with violet markings, larger ears (1.15), glowing violet eyes, and violet smoke wisps on the back, the hips, and the tail tip (on their own bones, with a sway in every clip). Mockup docs/monster-mockups/shadow-hound_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The glowing eyes and the violet markings read on the black body at 128 px.
It shares the body, the head, the rig, and the seven wolf clips through assets/parts/wolf-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for dire-wolf); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The smoke wisps are thin, so the shadow look is weak from the front.
next: Add one more wisp on each shoulder.

displacer-beast.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/displacer-beast) on the wolf kind. A blue-black beast with small ears, glowing green eyes, and two arched shoulder tentacles with spiked pads (two bones each); the attack whips the tentacles. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/displacer-beast_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The two arched tentacles give a clear silhouette from the front and the back.
It shares the body, the rig, and the wolf clips through assets/parts/wolf-kind.ts; the tentacles are thicker and arched after the first render; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The head is a wolf head, and the mockup head is more like a cat.
next: Give the kind a shorter muzzle option for cat heads.

giant-spider-queen.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/giant-spider-queen) on the new spider kind (assets/parts/spider-kind.ts). A violet spider with a cute face (glossy black eyes with glowing ember pupils, white cheek dots, a small smile), round palps like ears, a lumpy gold crown with blue gems (a crown slot), near-black leg bands, small fangs (0.55), and an orange chest disc with a violet trident. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-spider-queen_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The crown, the palps, and the cute face match the mockup and read at 128 px, also from above.
The giant spider became the spider kind with face, chest mark, band, fang, and extra hooks (mesh-same: SAME for giant-spider); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: It keeps the giant spider size, and a game must scale it up to show a boss.
next: Add a scale option to the spider kind if games need a bigger queen model.

hill-giant.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/hill-giant) on the new ogre kind (assets/parts/ogre-kind.ts), 1.45 times the orc size. Tan human skin, a bigger head (1.15) with a round nose and no tusks, a big brown beard and mop of hair, a shaggy fur collar, a fur loincloth, and the spiked club. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/hill-giant_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The beard, the fur collar, and the big belly read as a giant at 128 px.
The ogre brute became the ogre kind (mesh-same: SAME for ogre-brute); the hill giant shares its rig and eight clips; held items ok, ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup holds a plain club down at the side; here the spiked club is raised, as on the ogre.
next: Give the hill giant a plain club without the spike.

fire-giant.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/fire-giant) on the ogre kind, 1.45 times the orc size. Crimson skin, a round nose, a glowing orange flame beard and side locks (the strand shades are kind colors now), a crest of five flame tongues, dark iron shoulder plates (ogrePauldrons), iron bracers, and an iron war hammer. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/fire-giant_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The flame hair and the dark iron plates on the red body match the mockup.
It shares the rig and the eight ogre clips; the hammer block lies across the haft, so it stays above the ground in the low swipe; held items ok (2.6 cm), ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The hammer is smaller than the mockup hammer, because a longer head went below the ground in attack2.
next: Raise the low swipe of attack2 in the ogre kind, then make the hammer bigger.

frost-giant.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/frost-giant) on the ogre kind, 1.45 times the orc size. Ice-blue skin, a round nose, a big white beard and side locks, a steel-blue helmet with a ridge and two white horns, steel-blue shoulder plates and bracers, a white fur loincloth, and a frozen club with an ice spike. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/frost-giant_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The horned helmet and the white beard read at 128 px.
It shares the rig and the eight ogre clips; the club keeps the ogre club shape in ice colors; held items ok, ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup is armored on the legs too; here the legs are bare under the fur loincloth.
next: Add steel-blue knee guards.

cyclops.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/cyclops) on the ogre kind, 1.4 times the orc size with a bigger head (1.22). Olive green skin, one big eye under one heavy brow, a round nose, a wide grin with a row of teeth and small tusks (0.5), a short horn, a bald head, a fur loincloth, and a wooden mallet. The mockup was made again, because the first one had an eyeball for a head.
strengths: The one big eye and the toothy grin match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The ogre kind got the options for one eye, a grin, a human nose, a head scale, and the mane parts; held items ok, ground ok after the mallet drum turned across the haft, 0 warnings.
issues: The skin is a little more yellow than the olive mockup.
next: Move the skin toward olive.

colossal-golem.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/giant-and-ancient/colossal-golem) on the new golem kind (assets/parts/golem-kind.ts). Dark charcoal stone with faceted shading and no moss, a dark core, glowing cyan eyes and chest rune, and glowing cyan veins: zigzag chains that lie on the shoulder boulders and the limb blocks. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/colossal-golem_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The glowing veins and eyes on the dark stone read as an ancient colossus.
The stone golem became the golem kind (mesh-same: SAME for stone-golem); the veins are raycast chains, so they need no shell cut and reduce cleanly; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup head is a pointed helmet with angled eyes; here it keeps the round stone golem head, and the model keeps the stone golem size.
next: Add a head option to the golem kind for a pointed helmet head.

gremlin.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/small/gremlin) on the new goblin kind (assets/parts/goblin-kind.ts). A green tinkerer with bigger ears (1.28, no nicks), no crest, red eyes, two brown locks and a hair cap (a hair slot), a green body in brown overalls (bib, straps, two buttons), bare tan feet, and a steel wrench on the dagger bone. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/gremlin_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The huge ears, the red eyes, the overalls, and the wrench match the mockup.
The goblin warrior became the goblin kind with outfit, weapon, and extra hooks (mesh-same: SAME for goblin-warrior); the gremlin keeps the seven goblin clips; held items ok, ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The hair is a smooth cap, and the mockup hair has rough locks.
next: Add a few strand ridges to the hair cap.

giant-lizard.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/giant-lizard) on the dragon kind. The drake without wings, horns (new option horn: false), or head spines (new option headCrest: false): green scales with round yellow spots (jittered grid points), a cream belly, small yellow spines on the back and the tail, gold eyes, dark green brows, and a pale green acid spit in place of fire. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-lizard_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The round yellow spots and the hornless head set it apart from the drake at 128 px.
It shares the body, the rig, and the drake clips through assets/parts/dragon-kind.ts (mesh-same: SAME for dragon-fire and drake after the two new options); ground ok, forge all with 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup lizard is calm and stands low; this one keeps the dragon grin, the brows, and the upright chibi pose.
next: Give the dragon kind a calm face option (no teeth, soft brows).

basilisk.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/basilisk) on the dragon kind, without wings, horns, or head spines. Dark green scales, a pale yellow belly, a tall red spiked frill behind the head like a crown (a frill slot, with dark red rays), dark green back spines, yellow eyes, and a grey-green petrifying breath. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/basilisk_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The red frill reads as a crown from the front and the back at 128 px.
It shares the body, the rig, and the drake clips through assets/parts/dragon-kind.ts; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup basilisk has a slim serpent neck; here it keeps the round dragon body, and the frill is thin from the side.
next: Add a long-neck option to the dragon kind for serpent kinds.

kitsune.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/fey-and-spirit/kitsune) on the wolf kind with new calm-face options: no brows, no forelock, a thin closed smile without upper teeth, and a fur paint hook. Orange fur with white cheeks, muzzle, and chest, black ear tips and paws, a red triangle and dots on the forehead, white marks over the eyes, gold eyes, and three white-tipped tails (the wolf tail and two on their own bones that sway in every clip). Mockup docs/monster-mockups/kitsune_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The three tails, the forehead marks, and the calm smile match the mockup.
It shares the body, the rig, and the seven wolf clips (mesh-same: SAME for dire-wolf after the new options); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The chest ruff is spiky, and the mockup chest is smooth; the front legs take some white from the chest paint.
next: Add a smooth-chest option to the wolf kind.

scorpion.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/small/scorpion) on the spider kind with new options (no abdomen, no small eyes, no web spit, no chest mark, extra bones, and poses in every clip). A sandy shell with brown bands on the legs and the back, big round eyes, small fangs, two big pincers on arms (the outer finger opens on its own bone), and a segmented tail on five bones that curls over the back to a dark stinger; the attack opens and snaps the claws and strikes the tail over the head. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/scorpion_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The curled tail and the two pincers read at 128 px, also from above.
It shares the legs, the head, the rig, and the spider clips (mesh-same: SAME for giant-spider and giant-spider-queen); the tail strike stays above the head; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The spider legs are longer than the short legs of the mockup scorpion.
next: Add a leg length option to the spider kind.

giant-crab.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/giant-crab) on the spider kind with a new head option (a wide, low red dome as the shell), no fangs, no leg bands, no abdomen, no chest mark, and no web. A cream underside, a grumpy painted face (two dot eyes and a flat mouth), two white eyeballs on stalks, and two big raised claws on arms (the outer finger opens on its own bone, and the claws snap in idle and attack). Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-crab_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The raised claws and the eye stalks read as a crab at 128 px.
It shares the legs, the rig, and the spider clips; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The spider legs are long and thin, and the mockup crab legs are short and bent.
next: Add a leg length option to the spider kind (also for the scorpion).

abyssal-beast.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/abyssal-and-cosmic/abyssal-beast) on the wolf kind: crimson fur with a near-black muzzle, ruff, and tail tip, small ears, no brows or forelock, two big curved black horns, round glowing orange eyes, black paws, and glowing orange ember spots on the shoulders and legs. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/abyssal-beast_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The horns, the glowing eyes, and the ember spots match the mockup and read at 128 px.
It shares the body, the rig, and the seven wolf clips; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup chest is a smooth black oval; the wolf ruff is spiky and dark red.
The mockup embers have dark rims; these are plain glowing ovals.
next: Add a smooth-chest option to the wolf kind (also open for the kitsune).

dire-bear.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/dire-bear) on the boar kind with new bear options: a bear muzzle in the skin slot with a black nose and a stub tail, round ears, paws with claws in the ivory slot, smaller plain eyes, and no horns, tusks, or mane (the brows stay). Brown fur, a cream muzzle, dark brows. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/dire-bear_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The round ears, the cream muzzle, and the heavy body match the mockup; the bear reads from every side at 128 px.
Both boar bases stay identical after the new options (mesh-same SAME); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup eyes are closed angry slits; these are small open eyes.
The boar clips (charge, gore) are boar moves, not bear swipes.
next: Add a bear swipe clip to the boar kind if the game needs one.

owlbear.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/owlbear) on the goblin kind with new options (no ears, no face): a round brown body with a tan belly, a raised cream facial disc, big orange eyes, a hooked yellow beak, round bear ears, a white feather ruff, thick wing arms with black claws, and black talons. The image model drew the owlbear as a biped in three tries, so the asset is a biped. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/owlbear_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The owl face with bear ears and the white ruff match the mockup and read at 128 px.
Both goblin bases stay identical after the new options (mesh-same SAME); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The right wing is raised in front at rest (the goblin dagger arm); in the attack and the taunt the claws go into the belly (hidden, 7 to 9 cm).
next: Give the goblin kind a relaxed right arm option for kinds without a held item.

fairy-sprite.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/fey-and-spirit/fairy-sprite) on the imp kind with new options: upright ears, no horns, crest, tail, claws, brows, or bat wings, and a smile mouth. Mint skin, closed eyes with lashes, two glowing dots, pink cheeks, a leaf crown, a chest leaf, a leaf skirt, and two pairs of clear veined dragonfly wings on the wing bones. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/fairy-sprite_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The upright ears, the leaf crown, and the clear wings match the mockup.
The four imp bases stay identical after the new options (mesh-same SAME); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup holds its hands together; the imp arms reach forward.
The clear wings are faint at 128 px.
next: Raise the wing opacity a little if the sprites need stronger wings.

succubus.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/abyssal-and-cosmic/succubus) on the imp kind, reworked to the owner rule that every asset is rated G: a friendly little demon girl with pale skin, long lavender hair, two curved mauve horns, dark eyes, pink cheeks, a small smile, a lilac dress with short puffed sleeves, a white collar, and a white hem, small violet bat wings, and the arrow tail. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/succubus_001.jpg (mmx, made again for the rework).
strengths: The dress, the hair, and the horns match the new mockup; the face reads as friendly at 128 px.
It shares the imp rig and the six imp clips; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup has a pink bow on the collar and lace on the hem; the asset has a plain collar and hem.
The tail is skin-colored; the mockup tail is lilac.
The row name keeps its folklore meaning; a rename waits for the owner.
next: Rename the row to little-demon if the owner agrees.

eldritch-eye.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/abyssal-and-cosmic/eldritch-eye) on the spirit kind with new options (a head shape in place of the egg, no face): one big taupe eyeball with a white eye, a dark rim, faint red veins, a purple iris with a lumpy raised ring, and a black pupil, on a dark violet wisp body with taupe arms. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/eldritch-eye_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The one huge eye makes the silhouette and reads at 128 px.
The ghost, the forest spirit, and the fire elemental stay identical after the new options (mesh-same SAME); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup lower body is a ragged cloak with strands; the wisp is smooth.
next: Add ragged strands to the wisp if the abyss family needs more variety.

eldritch-horror.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/abyssal-and-cosmic/eldritch-horror) on the slime kind with new options: a matte skin, hollow eyes, no frown, no floating bubbles, and an extra-bodies hook. Purple with a round studded orb on the crown bone, raised eye sockets, a wide maw with a lip, a green throat, and white teeth, studs, and nine thick tentacles. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/eldritch-horror_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The orb, the toothy maw, and the tentacles match the mockup and read at 128 px.
Three slime bases stay identical after the new options (mesh-same SAME); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The tentacles are static on the core bone; they do not curl in the clips.
The mockup body is taller than the slime dome.
next: Give the tentacles bones and a slow curl if the game shows it large.

mushroom-creature.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/small/mushroom-creature) on the goblin kind (no ears, no face, own outfit): cream skin, a big red cap with raised white spots and pale gills, small round ears, black dot eyes, a small smile, a stem-like bell body, and short legs with round feet. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/mushroom-creature_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The spotted cap and the cream stem match the mockup; the cap reads from every side and from above.
It shares the goblin rig and clips; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The right arm is raised in front at rest (the goblin dagger arm).
next: Use the relaxed right arm option when the goblin kind has one.

giant-eagle.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/giant-eagle), the first asset on the new bird kind factory assets/parts/bird-kind.ts (egg body, head with painted eyes, hooked or short beak on a jaw bone, feathered thighs, scaly shins, four-toed feet, a fan tail, the griffin's wings, and the clips idle, walk, fly, attack, hit, death). A bald eagle: a dark brown egg body, a white head with white brow ridges and amber eyes, a hooked yellow beak, folded wings beside the body (wing rest -95, turn -35), a white tail fan, and yellow feet. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-eagle_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The white head on the dark egg body and the folded wings match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The waddle walk, the wing beats, the rear-up peck, and the fall onto the belly work (strips checked); ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: In the fly clip the folded wing rest makes the wing thin when seen edge-on at the top of the stroke.
next: Check the fly clip in a game camera before the eagle is a mount.

roc.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/roc) on the bird kind: a big round orange head with a tall red crest and big round dark eyes in white rims, a hooked yellow beak, a small orange body with a red feather bib, raised wings with yellow coverts and red flight feathers, a red and gold tail fan, and orange legs with black talons. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/roc_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The raised wings and the red crest make the silhouette, as in the mockup, also from behind.
It shares the bird rig and the six bird clips; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The wing arm in the body color shows as an orange bar in front of the yellow coverts; the mockup wing edge is yellow.
next: Add a wing-arm color option to the bird kind.

cockatrice.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/cockatrice) on the bird kind with a short beak, no tail fan, and three extra tail bones: a chubby white rooster with big yellow eyes, a red comb and wattle, a cream belly, small folded green wings, yellow feet, and a long green striped serpent tail with an arrow tip that sways in every clip and lashes in the attack. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/cockatrice_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The red comb on the white head and the green serpent tail read at 128 px from every side.
The bird kind's bones and pose hooks carry the serpent tail; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The mockup has white hands and large leafy wings; the asset has small folded wings.
next: Larger wings if the game needs a flying cockatrice.

giant-snake.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/giant-snake) on the new serpent kind (a spine path with root, spine, and tail bones, belly plates, and the round snake head with a jaw and a tongue bone): a green snake in one coil with the neck raised in an S, a big round head with big glossy black eyes, a forked pink tongue, a pale yellow belly with plate lines, and dark green diamonds along the back. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/giant-snake_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The raised head, the glossy eyes, and the yellow belly read at 128 px from every side.
The strike in the attack and the fall in the death bend only the raised part of the body; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: The coil is one open ring; the mockup coil is tighter and fatter.
next: A tighter coil with the tail tucked under, if the game needs it.

sea-serpent.summary: A P2 monster (catalog monsters/beast/sea-serpent) on the serpent kind with the new drake head (a long snout with a grin of square teeth and big eyes on top): an upright teal serpent curved like the number 3, a cream belly with plate lines on the front, triangle fins down the back, two small chest fins, and a tail with a three-lobed fan fin. Mockup docs/monster-mockups/sea-serpent_001.jpg (mmx).
strengths: The number-3 curve, the grin of teeth, and the tail fan read at 128 px from the sides.
The drake head and the frame helper of the kind serve the lindworm too; ground ok, 0 warnings.
issues: Spot check 2026-10-05: the side curve matches, but the teeth show black gaps and the front view is a thin white column. Below the bar; rework in asset_review_audit_20261005.
From the front the body is a narrow white column; the mockup only shows the side.
In the death the head folds into the lower loop for a moment.
next: A wider lower loop or a slight turn of the body, if the front view must read better.

sheep.next: Make the wool warm cream with soft raised curls and shallow crevices, as in the mockup.

cow.summary: The model is a four-legged chibi cow with gold horns, black patches, and a pink muzzle. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the bell, the fur, and the tail are clearly different.
strengths: The gold horns, the pink ears, and the large pink muzzle with nostrils match the mockup.
The black patches on the head and the body read at 128 px in every direction.
The walk clip lifts each hoof and keeps the body level.
issues: The bell hangs under the chin, and the muzzle hides it in the front view. Make the bell larger and move it down onto the chest, as in the mockup.
The whole body has a rough fur texture. The mockup has smooth clay. Reduce the fur bump on the body and the head.
The tail points back and down. The mockup tail curls up at the side with a dark tuft. Bend the tail up.
The eyes are small and sit under heavy brows. The mockup has larger, bright eyes. Increase the eye size and lift the brows.
The side view shows a long snout and eyes that bulge from the sides of the head. Shorten the snout and set the eyes into the face.
The hooves are black and tall. The mockup has short dark grey hooves with a split. Add the pink udder and the white head tuft from the mockup.
cow.next: Move a larger bell down onto the chest so that it reads in the front view and at 128 px.

ox.summary: A chibi ox on four legs with wide cream horns, a rope collar, and a bell. The front view is close to the mockup, but the face, the coat color, and the belly differ clearly.
strengths: The wide cream horns read in every sprite direction.
The big head, the round eyes, and the black hooves give chibi appeal.
The rope collar, the gold bell, and the tail tuft match the mockup.
The walk alternates the legs and swings the tail.
issues: The muzzle is too small and too pink. Make it wider, as wide as the head, and use the peach color of the mockup.
The cream belly patch is missing. Add the cream patch on the chest and the belly.
The coat is a dark red brown. Make it the lighter tan brown of the mockup.
The brow bumps above the eyes are missing. Add the two brow bumps.
In the side view, the muzzle points forward like a pig snout. Make the muzzle shorter and deeper.
The horns are wider than in the mockup and have a lumpy surface. Make them smooth and add the ring segments.
ox.next: Make the muzzle wide and peach colored, and add the cream belly patch.

yak.summary: A shaggy brown chibi yak with cream horns, a fringe, and a tan face. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hair shape is different.
strengths: The cream horns, the fringe over the eyes, and the tan face match the mockup.
The long hair gives a clear yak silhouette in the sprites.
The black hooves match.
issues: The hair hangs as flat, straight strips like a curtain. Make thick, wavy clumps with varied length, as in the mockup.
The tan lower legs show below the hair. Lengthen the hair so it covers the legs down to the hooves.
The tail is long like a horse tail. Make a short fluffy tail.
The muzzle is cream. Make it tan with dark nostrils.
yak.next: Rebuild the hair as thick wavy clumps that cover the legs.

camel.summary: The model is a tan chibi camel with a red and rainbow blanket. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the blanket, the muzzle, and the back line have clear differences.
strengths: The large head, the eyes with lashes, and the pointed ears match the mockup.
The long neck, the knee rings, the brown hooves, and the tail tuft match the mockup.
The tan and red palette matches the mockup, and the blanket colors read at 128 px.
issues: The blanket is a tall stack of rainbow layers. It stands up from the back like a fin. Make a flat red drape with ruffled edges that lies on the back, with the rainbow ruffles in one band at the center.
The hump does not show. Add a low hump under the blanket so that the back line rises behind the shoulders.
The muzzle is small and cream. Make a large, round muzzle in the head color with two large nostrils.
The neck is a straight diagonal. Give the neck the mockup curve: up from the chest, then forward under the head.
The hair tuft on the head is one tan knob. Make a group of brown curls.
The walk has small leg swings and no head motion. Increase the stride and add a small head bob.
camel.next: Replace the tall blanket stack with a flat, ruffled red drape on a low hump.

wolf.summary: The model is the same friendly chibi wolf as the mockup, with a big head, tall ears, a cream muzzle, and brown paws. The muzzle shape, the coat color, the chest bib, and the tail show clear differences.
strengths: The pose, the big head, and the friendly smile match the mockup.
The brown paws and the brown tail tip match the mockup.
The walk clip moves the legs in a clear four-beat pattern, and the feet stay on the ground.
The wolf looks friendlier than a monster wolf, as the role requires.
issues: The muzzle is two round cheek puffs with a small nose. The mockup has one wide cream jaw that pushes forward under the eyes. Make one large rounded jaw shape, and remove the separate puffs.
The coat is a neutral dark grey. The mockup coat is a light blue-grey. Make the coat lighter and cooler.
The tail is long, thin, and smooth with a pointed tip. The mockup tail is bushy, curves down, and ends in a fluffy dark tuft. Make the tail thicker and fluffier.
The cream chest bib is pale and small. The mockup has a large clear cream bib. Make the bib larger and brighter.
The ears are narrow and show little brown inside. The mockup ears are wide with a large brown inner area. Make the ears wider and show more brown.
Thin dark crease lines cross the muzzle under the cheek. Remove these lines.
The black brows and the white eye rings change the look of the eyes. The mockup eyes are large dark irises with highlights. Remove the white rings and soften the brows.
wolf.next: Make the muzzle one wide cream jaw that pushes forward, as in the mockup.

fox.summary: The model is the same chibi red fox as the mockup, and the sit strip matches the sitting pose. The cheek ruff, the muzzle, and the tail show clear differences, and thin crease lines show on the muzzle.
strengths: The orange coat, the black ear tips, and the dark paws match the mockup.
The big eyes with lashes give the face the same cute look as the mockup.
The sit clip puts the rump on the ground with the forepaws in front, as in the mockup.
The fox reads in all eight sprite directions.
issues: The cheek ruff is two small grey spikes beside a round white muzzle. The mockup has wide fluffy cream tufts that make the widest part of the head. Make the cheek tufts larger, softer, and cream, and blend them into the muzzle.
Thin dark crease lines cross the white muzzle and the cheek puffs. A crease also shows at the tail root from the back. Remove these lines.

The tail is a thin tube with bulges that points up and back. The mockup tail is a wide fluffy brush that curls around the side of the body. Make the tail fuller, and curl it around the body in the sit pose.
In the sit pose, the body hunches and the cream chest bib is hard to see. The mockup sits upright with straight forelegs and a clear cream bib. Lift the chest and straighten the forelegs.
The white parts are cool grey-white. The mockup uses warm cream. Make the white areas warmer.
The eyes have a full white ring around the iris. The mockup shows only a little white. Make the ring thinner.
fox.next: Replace the small cheek spikes with wide cream cheek tufts, and remove the crease lines on the muzzle.

dog.summary: The model is the same brown puppy with dark floppy ears, a red collar, and a gold bell. The mouth, the chest color, and the surface show clear differences from the mockup.
strengths: The dark brown floppy ears have the correct size and shape, and they read in all eight sprites.
The red collar and the gold bell read at 128 px.
The sit clip matches the mockup pose: the front legs are straight and the hind legs fold under the body.
The eyes are large and dark brown with white rims and highlights, and the cream brow spots are present.
issues: The mouth is a wide, flat black band across the muzzle. The mockup has a curved smile with raised corners. Change the mouth to a curved smile.
The chest is orange. The mockup has a large cream bib from the chin to the front legs. Paint the cream bib.
The fur bump is strong on the head and the body. The mockup has a smooth clay surface. Reduce the bump amplitude.
The front legs are thin and the front paws are small. The mockup paws are large with toe lobes. Make the legs thicker and add toe lobes to the paws.
The tongue is small and it does not read in the front sprite. Make the tongue larger.
dog.next: Change the flat black mouth band to a curved open smile and paint a large cream chest bib.

cat.summary: The model is the same orange tabby kitten with green eyes, stripes, whiskers, and a curled tail, and the sit pose matches. The muzzle, the white areas on the head, and a chest crease show clear differences.
strengths: The green eyes, the forehead stripes, and the curled tail read at 128 px.
The sit clip matches the mockup pose.
The leg stripes and the white paws match the mockup.
issues: The white muzzle is a large hard-edged puck. The mockup muzzle is small and soft. Make the muzzle smaller and blend its edge into the face.
A white band wraps around the lower half of the head in the side view. The mockup cheeks are orange with stripes. Keep the white on the muzzle, the chin, and the chest only.
In the sit clip, a dark crease line shows across the chest under the chin. Remove the crease.
The eyes are smaller than the mockup eyes and have one small highlight. Make the eyes larger and add a second highlight.
The fur bump is strong. The mockup has a smooth clay surface. Reduce the bump amplitude.
The pink inner ears are faint. Make the inner ear pink stronger.
cat.next: Make the white muzzle smaller and soft, and keep the white off the sides of the head.

familiar-cat.summary: The model is a close black cat with large glowing purple eyes, a head spike, and a purple collar, and the sit pose matches. The moon charm is too small to read at 128 px, and the collar has no glow.
strengths: The large purple eyes glow and read in every front-facing sprite.
The sit clip matches the mockup pose and the head-to-body proportion.
The small head spike and the curled tail match the mockup.
issues: The moon charm is small and dim lilac. It does not read at 128 px. Make the charm larger and give it a bright white-lavender glow.
The collar is thin and dark purple. The mockup collar glows. Make the collar wider and make it emissive.
The fur bump hides the form of the black body. The mockup has a smooth satin surface with highlights. Reduce the bump and lower the roughness so that highlights show the form in dark scenes.
The nose is purple-grey. The mockup nose is black. Make the nose black.
The long white whiskers are not in the mockup, and they add noise in the sprites. Make the whiskers shorter and thinner.
The purple inner ears are faint. Make the inner ear purple stronger.
familiar-cat.next: Make the moon charm larger and bright, so that it reads at 128 px and in dark scenes.

riding-wolf.summary: The model is a gray chibi wolf with a brown saddle and a teal pad. The body and the paws match the mockup, but the face has a different expression and a different color pattern.
strengths: The large head on a short body gives the mockup chibi proportion.
The white socks and the black paws match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The teal pad and the brown leather read as a mount saddle.
issues: The expression is different. The brows press down on the eyes and the mouth is a flat line, so the wolf looks angry. Make large eyes with a calm upper lid and a side smile, as in the mockup.
The cream face mask is missing. Paint the lower half of the face, the cheeks, and the chest cream. Keep the gray on the top of the head.
The muzzle is a white ball that projects from the head, and the cheek tufts look like separate parts. Blend the muzzle into the face and make the cheeks part of the cream mask.
The saddle sits at the center of the back. Move the harness forward, with the chest strap, the ring, and the side bags, as in the mockup.
The tail has no white tip. Paint the tip white.
riding-wolf.next: Change the face to the mockup: a cream lower face, large calm eyes, and a side smile.

boar.summary: The model is the same brown boar piglet with a pink snout, cream tusks, a black crest, and cheek spikes. The head and the body merge into one ball, and the crest and the eyes differ clearly from the mockup.
strengths: The pink snout and the cream tusks read at 128 px.
The black crest, the cheek spikes, and the tufted tail are present.
The black hooves and the brown coat match the mockup colors.
issues: The head and the body merge into one ball. The mockup has a large head on a smaller, upright body. Separate the head from the body and make the body smaller.
The crest is a short dark clump with two prongs. The mockup crest is a swept row of black spikes from the brow to the neck. Extend the crest along the top of the head.
The eyes are smaller than the mockup eyes. Make the eyes larger.
The inner ears show no pink. Paint pink inside the ears.
The fur bump is strong. The mockup has a smooth clay surface. Reduce the bump amplitude.
The shoulder spikes look like separate black thorns in the side view. Blend the spikes into the coat.
boar.next: Separate a large head from a smaller body, so that the proportion matches the upright chibi mockup.

pig.summary: The model is the same round pink pig with large ears, black eyes, a big snout, rosy cheeks, and a curly tail. The skin surface, the mouth, and the color show clear differences from the mockup.
strengths: The snout, the black eyes, and the rosy cheeks read in the front sprites.
The curly tail reads in the side sprites.
The grey hooves and the round body match the mockup.
issues: The skin has a strong rough bump that looks like stucco. The mockup skin is smooth and glossy. Remove the bump and lower the roughness.
The mouth is small and hides under the snout. The mockup has a large open smile with a pink tongue. Make the mouth wider and show it below the snout.
The pink is a dull salmon. The mockup pink is lighter and warmer. Make the base color lighter.
The ears are thin flat plates in the side view. Give the ears thickness and a small forward fold.
The head merges into the body. The mockup has a large head on a pear-shaped body. Define the head with a small neck crease.
pig.next: Remove the rough skin bump and make the pink skin smooth and glossy.

bear.summary: The model is a chibi brown bear on four legs with round ears, a tan muzzle, and a black nose. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the pose, the side profile, and the feet are clearly different.
strengths: The front face reads well: round ears, a tan muzzle, a black nose, and large glossy eyes.
The brown and tan palette matches the mockup.
The fur bump on the body and the gloss on the eyes and the nose make the materials read.
The sprites show a bear in all 8 directions. The face reads in the S, SW, and SE sprites.
issues: The mockup bear stands in a low crouch with bent front legs and the head down. The model stands straight on four post legs. Bend the rest pose toward the crouch, or lower the head and the shoulders.
In the side view, the head merges into the shoulder hump with no neck. Make the head a distinct large sphere in front of a smaller body, as in the mockup.
The black feet are thick cylinders with a hard edge at the ankle. They look like boots. Make them flat paws with toes and a soft color blend, as in the mockup.
The eyes are small black beads with a light ring around them. The mockup eyes are larger, with a brown iris and a white highlight. Make the eyes larger and add a brown iris.
In the side view, the ear shows as a thin pointed flap. Give the ear more depth so that it reads round from every view.
The walk is readable, but the legs stay stiff and some paws tilt in the air. Add a body bob and keep the paws flat at contact.
bear.next: Give the head a distinct round shape and a neck in the side view, and lower the rest pose toward the crouch of the mockup.

badger.summary: The model is a smooth chibi badger with a striped white face, a grey body, and black legs. It is close to the mockup in the front view, but the side view shows a low, long head.
strengths: The striped white face reads at 128 px in every direction.
The smooth clay surface and the grey, white, and black value plan match the mockup.
The large glossy eyes and the small smile give a friendly face.
issues: The head sits low and points forward in line with the back. The mockup head is raised on the neck. Lift the head and tilt it up.
The side view shows a long, pointed snout. The mockup snout is shorter and the head is rounder. Shorten the snout.
The side view shows a hard vertical line between the white head and the grey body. Blend the white cheeks into a cream chest, as in the mockup.
The black stripes stop near the eyes. In the mockup, the stripes run up over the head to the ears. Extend the stripes to the ears.
The chest is pure white. The mockup chest is cream. Warm the chest color.
badger.next: Lift the head on the neck and shorten the snout to match the mockup side silhouette.

hedgehog.summary: The model is a chibi hedgehog with a chocolate spine coat, a cream face, and a pointed nose. It matches the mockup closely, and only small differences remain.
strengths: The side view is very close to the mockup: the round spine coat, the pointed cream snout, and the black nose.
The spine coat and the pointed nose read in every sprite direction at 128 px.
The color plan has a clear contrast between the dark coat and the cream face.
issues: The front legs spread out to the sides in the front view. The mockup legs stand under the body. Move the front feet in.
The spines have sharp points. The mockup spines are round knobs. Make the spine tips rounder.
The inner ears are pink. The mockup ears are cream. Paint the inner ears cream.
The hind feet kick up behind the coat in the walk clip. Keep the hind feet lower and plant them for longer.
The nose is large in the front view. Make the nose a little smaller.
hedgehog.next: Move the front feet under the body.

rabbit.summary: The model is a close match of the mockup rabbit: a cream head, long pink ears, a grey body, and a white tail. The eyes are smaller and the head is rounder than in the mockup.
strengths: The palette matches the mockup: cream head, pink inner ears, grey body, and white tail.
The long upright ears, the pink nose, the whiskers, and the lashes match the mockup.
The sitting pose matches the mockup.
The ears and the face read at 128 px.
issues: The eyes are smaller and lighter than in the mockup. Make them approximately 20 percent larger and darker, with a larger highlight.
The head is a round ball with a hard edge at the grey neck. The mockup head is an egg shape with full cheeks. Make the lower cheeks wider.
The hop clip only moves the body up and down. Extend the hind legs in the hop.
The feet are white with toe lines. The mockup feet are round cream pads.
rabbit.next: Make the eyes larger and darker, as in the mockup.

hare.summary: The model is a slim chibi hare with large flared black-tipped ears, large amber eyes, and thin legs with black feet. It matches the mockup with small differences in the eyes, the mouth, and the head color.
strengths: The large flared ears with black tips match the mockup and read in every sprite direction.
The thin legs, the black feet, the cream chest, and the round tail follow the mockup.
The front view is very close to the mockup in silhouette and proportion.
The run clip has a full stretch and gather, and the ears move with the body.
issues: The eyes have a thick orange rim that bulges out. The mockup eyes have a brown iris with an amber lower half and a thin dark outline. Make the rim thinner and flatter.
The face has no mouth. The mockup has a small mouth line. Add a small mouth line under the nose.
The head is one flat orange color. The mockup has a darker crown on the forehead and lighter cheeks. Add the darker crown.
The inner ears are pale cream. The mockup inner ears are a warmer peach. Make the inner ears warmer.
The tail is a brown ball. The mockup tail is darker, almost black. Make the tail darker.
hare.next: Make the eye rims thinner and flatter, and add the small mouth line.

squirrel.summary: The model is a cute orange squirrel with a big head, tufted ears, and a large tail. The run clip uses a four-leg gallop, but the mockup runs upright with the forepaws held at the chest, and the tail shape is different.
strengths: The coat color and the cream chest and cheeks match the mockup.
The ear tufts and the large tail make the animal easy to identify in every sprite direction.
The head is large and has chibi appeal.
The model stands on the ground, faces +Z, and has walk, run, hop, idle, attack, hit, and death clips.
issues: The run strip shows a four-leg gallop with the forepaws on the ground. The mockup runs on the hind legs with the torso up and the forepaws held together at the chest. Change the run pose to match the mockup, or add a clip that does.
The tail is a tall S-shaped plume. The mockup tail is a large round ball of curled fur behind the body. Make the tail rounder and fuller, and curl the tip down toward the back.

The eyes have a full white ring around the iris, and this gives a startled stare. The mockup eyes are large dark irises with highlights and only a little white at the side. Remove most of the white ring.
The tail has a fine noise texture. The mockup tail has large swirled locks. Add large curl grooves to the tail.
The tail keeps the same shape in every run frame. Add a small delayed swing to the tail.
squirrel.next: Make the run pose upright with the forepaws held at the chest, as in the mockup.

bat.summary: The model is a sitting chibi bat with tall ears with orange rims, a cream face mask, spread wings, and paws at the chest. It is very near the mockup in shape and color; the muzzle, the eyes, and the wing position differ a little.
strengths: The silhouette follows the mockup: tall ears with rims, spread wings, a round body, and small orange feet.
The brown and cream palette follows the mockup, and the cream face mask puts contrast on the face.
The fly clip moves the wings up and down in a clear beat, and the body bobs.
issues: The face is flat and the nose is small. Add the short muzzle and the larger black nose of the mockup.
The eyes are a little small. Make them larger, with a larger dark iris, as in the mockup.
The smile is short. Make it wider, as in the mockup.
The wings attach high at the shoulders. Set them lower, near the hips, as in the mockup.
bat.next: Add the short muzzle and the larger nose of the mockup, and make the eyes larger.

bee.summary: A chibi bee with a round yellow head, a banded fuzzy body, clear wings, and knobbed antennae. It is the same character as the mockup, but the eyes, the head, and the pose differ clearly.
strengths: The yellow and black bands read at 128 px in every direction.
The knobbed antennae and the smile match the mockup.
The fuzzy body, the smooth head, the glossy eyes, and the clear wings are different materials that read.
The model is clean, with no holes and no poke-through.
issues: The eyes are black with a thin white ring. Give them large white sclera and black pupils that look to the side, as in the mockup.
The rest pose stands on six splayed legs like a spider. The mockup flies with the legs down and relaxed. Lift the rest pose off the ground and let the legs hang.
The head is smooth. Add the fuzzy yellow tuft on the top of the head.
The body is as wide as the head. Make the body smaller than the head.
The wing beat in the fly clip is small. Increase the wing beat.
bee.next: Change the eyes to white sclera with black side-glance pupils.

wasp.summary: The model is a cute wasp with the correct face and a pointed striped abdomen. The abdomen is too long, and the thin straight legs make a stilt stance.
strengths: The face matches the mockup: large black eyes with highlights and a small red smile.
The pointed, striped abdomen with a stinger makes the wasp different from the round bee at 128 px.
The fly clip lifts the wasp and the legs hang below it, as in the mockup.
issues: The abdomen is approximately two times the mockup length. Make it shorter and rounder, and keep the point.
The six legs are thin and straight, and they stand in one cluster under the thorax. The mockup legs are thick and bent. Make the legs thicker, bend them, and spread them.
The thorax is plain yellow. The mockup thorax is black with a yellow band. Paint the thorax to match the mockup.
The antennae end in tight hooks. The mockup antennae curve back in a smooth arc.
wasp.next: Make the abdomen shorter and give the legs thicker, bent segments.

butterfly.summary: The model is a close 3D version of the mockup butterfly. The face, the curled antennae, and the spotted orange wings match, but the wings are larger and flatter in color.
strengths: The face matches the mockup: a dark cap with a V point, large glossy eyes, pink cheeks, and a small smile.
The curled antennae and the black wing edges with white spots match the mockup.
The orange wings read at 128 px in all eight directions.
The fly clip flaps the wings and moves the body up and down.
issues: The wings are a flat, matte orange. The mockup wings are glossy and translucent, with a darker amber near the body. Add the gradient and the gloss.
The wings are approximately 30 percent larger than in the mockup, and the lower wings are as large as the upper wings. Make the lower wings smaller.
In the side view, the wings show as thin plates, and the lower wing reaches the ground. Angle the wings out a little.
The arms stay stiff in the fly clip. Add a small arm motion.
butterfly.next: Give the wings the glossy amber gradient of the mockup and make the lower wings smaller.

moth.summary: The model is the same chibi moth as the mockup, with a brown face, a cream hood, knobbed antennae, and spotted wings. The hood, the antennae, the wings, and the arms show clear differences from the mockup.
strengths: The face matches the mockup: big glossy eyes, a small nose, and an open smile with a pink tongue.
The front layout reads correctly: the hood frames the face, the antennae point up, and the wings spread to the sides.
The wing dots and the antenna knobs read in the 128 px sprites.
The wings attach cleanly to the body, and the fly clip moves the wings in a clear flap.
issues: The hood has tight horizontal rope rows. The mockup has soft tufts that point out from the face like a mane. Make the hood from radial tufts, and make it wider at the cheeks.

The hood covers the full back of the head. From the side and the back, the head looks like a ribbed beehive, and the side view hides the face. Make the back of the hood smaller, or give it the same tufts as the front.
The antennae have small knobs on long thin stalks. The mockup has large knobs on short thick stalks that lean out. Make the knobs larger and the stalks shorter and thicker.
The wings are more saturated orange and larger than the mockup wings. The mockup wings are pale tan with one large dot each. Make the wing color lighter and use fewer, larger dots.
The arms are small stubs under the hood, and the legs are not present. The mockup has thin arms that reach out and two small feet. Add the arms and the feet.
The face is darker brown than the mockup face. Make the face skin a lighter warm brown.
The body stands on the ground. The mockup floats above the ground. Lift the body in the rest pose and in the fly clip.
moth.next: Rebuild the hood as soft radial tufts that frame the face, like the mockup mane.

crocodile.summary: The model is a chibi crocodile with a long snout, large top eyes, a cream chest, and back scutes. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the pose is lower and flatter, and the head is smaller.
strengths: The large white eyes on the top of the head read in most sprite directions.
The cream chest, the teeth, and the row of scutes match the mockup.
The side silhouette with the long tail is clear as a cutout.
The walk clip moves all four legs and keeps the body level.
issues: The body is low and flat. In the mockup, the chest is high and the head is above the line of the back. Raise the chest and the head.
The head is small and the snout is long. In the mockup, the head is larger and the snout is shorter and thicker. Make the head larger and the snout shorter, with raised nostrils at the tip.
The mouth line is straight. In the mockup, the mouth curves up into a smile. Curve the mouth corners up.
The front legs spread out to the sides. In the mockup, the legs are straight and under the body. Move the legs under the body.
The skin is one green material with little value change. Make the belly side and the back scutes slightly different in value to give a clearer value plan.
crocodile.next: Raise the chest and hold the head up, so that the side silhouette matches the mockup.

crab.summary: The model is a round red crab with raised claws, big eyes, two small horns, and a wide smile. It matches the mockup closely, and the main difference is the long thick legs.
strengths: The round body, the raised claws, the eyes, the horns, and the smile match the mockup.
The red color matches the mockup palette and the black smile is a clear focal point.
The face and the claws read at 128 px in the front directions.
issues: The legs are long, straight, thick tubes that spread out like fingers. The mockup legs are short and bent, with joints, and stay under the body. Make the legs shorter and bend them at a joint.
The walk clip moves the legs only a small distance. Give the legs a larger side step and add a small body sway.
In the side view the raised claw hides the eye. Move the claw arm back a little.
The surface is smooth. The mockup has a soft clay texture. Add a small surface bump.
crab.next: Make the legs short and bent at a joint so that they stay under the body, as in the mockup.

frog.summary: The model is a sitting chibi frog with large lidded eyes, a pale chin, and a pale belly. The body plan matches the mockup, but the mouth gives a different expression.
strengths: The sitting pose, the wide head, and the large eyes on the top of the head match the mockup.
The pale chin and the pale belly read clearly in the S, SW, and SE sprites.
The dark spots on the legs match the mockup.
The walk clip moves the frog forward in short hops.
issues: The model has a painted wide smile. The mockup has a neutral mouth with a large round lower jaw. Remove the smile line. Make the pale lower jaw larger and rounder.
The eyelids cover less of the eyes than in the mockup. Lower the eyelids to give the calm, half-closed look.
The green is a bright lime. The mockup green is softer. Make the green less saturated.
The front legs spread out wide. In the mockup, the front legs are straight and near the belly. Move the front legs nearer to the body.
In the side view and in the W and E sprites, the head has a lumpy shape around the eye. Make the side of the head smooth.
frog.next: Replace the painted smile with a large round pale lower jaw, as in the mockup.

fish.summary: A round blue toy fish with a yellow underside, yellow-rimmed eyes, and an open smile. It matches the mockup with small differences in the fins and the body shape.
strengths: The blue and yellow two-tone body matches the mockup.
The large eyes with yellow rims and the open smile match the mockup face.
The fish reads clearly at 128 px in all directions.
issues: The body is round and tall. The mockup body is a little longer than it is tall. Stretch the body a little along its length.
The tail fin is small. Make the tail fin larger and wider like the mockup fan.
The pectoral fins and the dorsal fin are small. Make them larger.
The swim clip moves only the tail a small amount. Add a body sway.
fish.next: Make the tail fin and the side fins larger.

trout.summary: The model is a chubby olive trout with dark spots, a pink cheek, a rosy band, and a pale belly. Heavy white lids make the eyes look sleepy, and the head is smaller than in the mockup.
strengths: The olive back, the pale belly, the pink cheek, and the gill line match the mockup palette.
The low fins act as feet, as in the mockup.
The fan tail and the round dorsal fin make a clear fish silhouette at 128 px.
The swim clip sweeps the tail and moves the fins.
issues: Heavy white lids cover the top of each eye. The eyes look sleepy. The mockup eyes are round and wide open with a thin pale rim. Remove the lids and use a thin rim.
The head is small compared with the body. The mockup head is about 40 percent of the body length and has a round forehead. Make the head larger and shorten the body.
The mouth is a small pursed lip. The mockup mouth is larger with full pink lips. Make the mouth larger and pink.
The spots in the rosy band are pink rings near the tail. The mockup has red spots along the full band. Use red spots along the band.
The dark back spots are small and dense. They make noise at 128 px. Use fewer and larger spots.
trout.next: Replace the heavy eye lids with round, wide open eyes that have a thin pale rim.

seal.summary: The model is a grey seal pup with the black nose, the whiskers, and the sleepy eyes of the mockup. The body is short and tall, but the mockup body is long and low.
strengths: The round grey head, the black nose, and the whiskers match the mockup.
The front flippers spread out as in the mockup.
The round grey shape and the black nose read at 128 px.
issues: The body is a short, tall hump behind the head. The mockup body is long and low. Make the body longer and lower.
The tail flippers are small and almost vertical. The mockup tail flippers are large and curve up behind the body. Make them larger and curve them up.
The brow lines above the eyes make the face look a little cross. The mockup eyes are calm. Make the brow lines softer.
The swim clip moves only the flippers. Add a wave along the body.
seal.next: Make the body longer and lower, and add larger tail flippers that curve up.

turtle.summary: A light green pond turtle with a big round head, black eyes, a smile, and a dark green plated shell with a cream rim. It matches the mockup with small differences.
strengths: The head, the eyes, and the smile match the mockup.
The shell plates and the cream rim match the mockup.
The turtle reads clearly at 128 px, and the walk clip moves the stubby legs.
issues: The neck rises nearly vertical, so the head sits high. The mockup head reaches more forward. Tilt the neck forward.
The smile is small. The mockup smile is wider and clearer. Widen the smile.
The shell is a little low. The mockup shell is a taller dome.
turtle.next: Tilt the neck forward so the head reaches out like the mockup.

octopus.summary: The model is a very close 3D version of the mockup octopus. The color is a stronger blue violet than the soft lilac of the mockup, and the eyes are a little smaller.
strengths: The round dome with small bumps and the curled arms match the mockup.
The face matches the mockup: glossy eyes, pink cheeks, and a small smile.
The walk clip waves the arms with overlap, and the dome moves with them.
The dome and the arms read at 128 px in all eight directions.
issues: The purple is more saturated and bluer than the soft lilac of the mockup. Make the color lighter and pinker.
The eyes are a little smaller than in the mockup. Make them approximately 15 percent larger.
The arms spread wider than in the mockup. Move the arm tips closer under the dome.
The dome surface shows a fine, lumpy noise. The mockup dome is smooth, with a few small dots.
octopus.next: Change the body color to the soft lilac of the mockup.

eel.summary: The model is a cute green eel with the large head, the side eyes, the crest, and the ribbed cream belly of the mockup. The body is thick, so the S curve is weak, and the green is a cool mint.
strengths: The large head, the black side eyes, the smile, and the crest match the mockup.
The ribbed cream belly and the spiked tail match the mockup.
The head and the curve read at 128 px.
issues: The neck and the body are thick, so the S curve is weak. The mockup neck is thin, and the tail lies on the ground before it curls up. Make the neck and the body thinner.
The green is a cool mint. The mockup green is a warmer yellow green. Make the green warmer.
The head is a large dome with the eyes at its edges. The mockup head is smaller relative to the body.
The walk clip moves only the head and the tail tip. Add a wave along the body.
eel.next: Make the neck and the body thinner so that the S curve reads clearly.

salmon.summary: The model is a chubby salmon with a pink body, a forked tail, and a friendly face, close to the mockup. The back is a light sage grey, but the mockup back is a dark slate grey.
strengths: The body shape, the face, and the smile are close to the mockup.
The forked tail and the dorsal fin match the mockup.
The pink and grey body reads at 128 px.
The tail sweeps clearly in the swim clip.
issues: The back is a light grey with a green tint. The mockup back is a dark slate grey. Make the back darker and bluer for a strong contrast with the pink side.
A dark spot shows at the root of the pectoral fin in the swim clip. Fix the fin root.
The smile is a thin line. The mockup smile is wider, with gill lines behind it.
The pectoral fins are small and sit low on the body.
salmon.next: Paint the back the dark slate grey of the mockup.

dolphin.summary: The model is a grey dolphin with a round head, a beak, a white belly, and a yellow dorsal fin. It matches the mockup with small differences in the beak, the smile, and the belly color.
strengths: The round head, the beak, the eyes, and the yellow dorsal fin match the mockup.
The upright sitting pose with the tail behind matches the mockup.
The swim clip rocks the body and moves the flippers and the tail.
issues: The beak is a little short and the mouth is a thin line. The mockup beak is wider and longer, with a clear upturned smile. Make the beak longer and deepen the smile.
The belly is pure white and is the brightest area on the model. The mockup belly is a soft cream. Make the belly a soft cream so that the face stays the focal point.
The dorsal fin is a thin stick in the back view. Make the fin thicker at the base.
The front flippers are short. The mockup flippers are longer. Make them a little longer.
dolphin.next: Make the beak longer and wider with a clear upturned smile, as in the mockup.

crow.summary: The model is a dark slate crow with a crest, scalloped feathers, and a heavy beak. It is near the mockup. The differences are small.
strengths: The silhouette, the body plan, and the stern face agree with the mockup.
The scalloped feather rows on the chest and the wings agree with the mockup.
The glossy beak and the matte feathers are different materials.
issues: The eyes are dark brown. At 128 px they are almost not visible on the dark head. Make the eyes black and add a lighter grey lid ring, as in the mockup.
The head is smooth. The mockup head has sculpted feather texture. Add shallow feather grooves to the head and the crest.
The feet are a light lavender grey. The mockup feet are dark grey. Make the feet darker.
crow.next: Make the eyes read at 128 px: black eyes with a lighter grey lid ring.

familiar-raven.summary: A round black raven with glowing violet eyes, a violet ribbon, and a crescent charm. It is the same character as the mockup, but the head, the beak, and the feathers differ clearly.
strengths: The glowing violet eyes and the violet ribbon read at 128 px and give a clear focal accent.
The crescent charm and the hanging ribbon end match the mockup.
The chest feathers, the folded wings, and the tail fan support the round body.
The model is clean and stands on its feet.
issues: The head is a smooth ball on top of the body. Add the ruffled feather tufts on the crown and the cheeks, and blend the head into the body as one egg form.
The beak is small, black, and hooked. Make it larger, grey, and wedge shaped as in the mockup.
The body is wider than the head at the bottom. Make the head as wide as the body.
In the side view, feather spikes stick out of the seam between the head and the body. Smooth the seam.
The walk shows little foot motion. Lift the feet more and add a body waddle.
familiar-raven.next: Add the feather tufts on the head and blend the head into the body.

falcon.summary: The model is a slate and cream falcon with yellow eye rings and dark cheek stripes. The face is close to the mockup, but the body is a tall column and not a pear shape.
strengths: The slate hood, the cream face, and the dark stripes from the eyes read at 128 px.
The low brows give the same worried look as the mockup.
The wings, the chest dots, and the yellow feet with black talons match the mockup.
issues: The body is a tall column with straight sides. Make the body a pear shape that is wider at the bottom, and make the head smaller than the body.
The eyes are larger than in the mockup. Make the eyes smaller.
The white legs are long and visible. Make the legs shorter so that the feet sit under the belly.
The tail is a thin flat paddle that looks like a hand in the side sprites. Give the tail volume or make it smaller.
The back of the neck shows a ledge between the head and the body. Blend the head into the back.
falcon.next: Make the body a pear shape that is wider at the bottom.

owl.summary: The model is a chibi brown owl with ear tufts, a pale face disc, a heart belly, and spots. It is very near the mockup. The differences are small.
strengths: The ear tufts, the face disc, and the heart belly agree with the mockup.
The big eyes in the pale face read at 128 px.
The spots give detail at the edges, and the belly stays calm.
issues: The irises are a saturated orange without a dark rim. Use a warmer amber and add a dark outer ring, as in the mockup.
The dark V mark between the eyes is missing. Add it on the forehead.
