A faint circle line shows on each cheek next to the face disc. Remove the seam.
The wings hang straight down. The mockup wings stand a little out from the body.
owl.next: Change the irises to amber with a dark outer ring, and add the V mark between the eyes.

pigeon.summary: The model is a grey pigeon with orange eyes, a green neck, a violet ruff, and pink feet. The face and the colors match the mockup, but the body, the ruff, and the wings have clear differences.
strengths: The orange eyes, the white cere, and the dark beak match the mockup.
The green neck sheen and the pink feet read in all eight sprites.
The wing bars and the dark wing tips match the mockup.
issues: The wings are behind the body, so the front view is a plain tall egg. Move the wings forward to the sides of the body, as in the mockup.
The violet ruff is a regular ring around the neck. Make it a scalloped bib that hangs lower at the front of the chest.
The body is tall and narrow at the base. Make the body shorter and wider at the bottom.
The legs have grey feather thighs. Show short pink legs below the body.
The walk has no head bob. Add the forward and back head bob of a pigeon.
pigeon.next: Move the wings forward to the sides of the body so that the front silhouette matches the mockup.

sparrow.summary: The model is a brown sparrow with a grey cap, a cream face, and a black bib. It is close to the mockup, but the bib, the legs, and the eyes are clearly different.
strengths: The grey cap with a tuft, the cream face, and the brown body match the mockup palette.
The stern brows match the mockup expression.
The grey cap and the black bib read at 128 px in the front directions.
issues: The black bib is large and has a jagged lower edge, so it looks like a beard. Make the bib smaller, with three round lobes, directly below the beak.
The pink legs are long and thick. Make the legs shorter so that the body sits lower.
The eyes are larger than in the mockup. Make the eyes smaller.
The wings have dark stripes that the mockup does not have. Make the wings plain brown.
The tail is a flat paddle that looks like a hand in the back sprites. Give the tail volume.
sparrow.next: Make the bib smaller, with three round lobes, directly below the beak.

rooster.summary: The model is a round chibi rooster with a red comb, orange neck feathers, a brown body, and a dark green tail. The palette and the body match the mockup, but the tail shape is clearly different.
strengths: The palette matches the mockup: a red comb and wattle, orange neck feathers, a brown body, and a pale belly.
The red comb is a clear accent at the head.
The round body and the feathered wing match the mockup.
The walk clip moves the legs and the tail.
issues: The tail is one solid shape with short round ends, like a glove. In the mockup, the tail has separate long feathers that arch up and curl down. Make three or four separate feathers with gaps between them.
The legs are long, thick, and yellow. In the mockup, the legs are shorter, thinner, and orange. Make the legs shorter and thinner. Change the leg color to orange.
The neck feathers are short and stop at the shoulders. In the mockup, the neck feathers are longer and have yellow tips. Make them longer and add yellow tips.
In the S sprite, the tail shows as a thin dark spike above the comb. Lower the tail so that the comb is the highest point in the front view.
In the sprites, the eyes are small and look like narrow slits. Make the eyes larger and rounder.
rooster.next: Split the tail into separate long feathers that arch up and curl down, as in the mockup.

raven.summary: The model is a shaggy black raven with a heavy beak and violet cheek tufts. It is close to the mockup, but the eyes, the side profile, and the dark values have clear differences.
strengths: The crest, the shaggy throat, and the violet tufts match the mockup.
The heavy beak and the shaggy throat make it different from a crow in the front view.
The parts are clean and attached, and the feet stand on the ground.
issues: The eyes are half closed with flat lids. The mockup eyes are wide, with brown irises and angled brows. Open the eyes, add brown irises, and angle the brows down to the center.
The beak is short in the side view, so the side profile loses the heavy beak. Make the beak longer and deeper.
The face is smooth, but the mockup head has feather texture. Add feather clumps to the cheeks and the crown.
All parts are very dark, so the forms do not read. Add a lighter rim and a blue-grey sheen on the feathers.
The throat feathers make a full ring around the chest. Make a shaggy cascade at the center of the throat.
raven.next: Open the eyes and add brown irises with angled brows, as in the mockup.

eagle.summary: The model is a chibi eagle with a golden head, a grey collar, and a brown body. It is the same bird as the mockup, but the head feathers and the collar color are clearly different.
strengths: The golden head on the dark body reads at 128 px in every direction.
The eyes, the beak, and the yellow feet with black talons match the mockup.
The body color plan and the wing shape match the mockup.
issues: The head feathers are spikes that point out around the face, like a mane. Make layered, rounded feather tufts on the crown and the back of the head, as in the mockup.
The collar is a light purple-grey. Make the collar a dark charcoal grey.
The face has no brows, so the eagle looks surprised. Add a low brow ridge above each eye.
The tail is a thin flat plate that shows edge-on from the side. Give the tail volume.
A hard horizontal line separates the head from the body. Blend the head into the collar.
eagle.next: Replace the spikes around the face with layered, rounded feather tufts on the crown.

hawk.summary: The model is a chibi hawk with a brown cap, a cream face and chest, brown spots, and a rusty tail. The body and the palette are close to the mockup, but the head and the eyes are clearly different.
strengths: The rusty tail and the spotted cream chest read in the sprites.
The brown collar with a jagged edge, the brown spots, and the yellow feet with dark talons match the mockup.
The open smile below the beak matches the mockup expression.
The palette is clear: brown, cream, yellow, and a rusty accent.
issues: The brown cap covers only the top and the back of the head. In the mockup, the brown hood comes down at the sides and frames the face. Extend the brown down to the cheeks.
The eyes are flat black dots. In the mockup, the eyes have brown irises, large highlights, and soft lids. Add brown irises and lids.
The crest is a crown of straight vertical spikes. In the mockup, the crest is a small tuft that sweeps back. Make the crest smaller and bend it back.
The head is tall and narrow. Make the head rounder and wider, as in the mockup.
The cream is pale and cool. The mockup cream is a warm yellow. Make the cream warmer.
In the side view of the walk clip, the tail turns and shows as a thin blade. Keep the tail fan open during the walk.
In the front view and in the S sprite, the tail ends show as orange shapes beside the head. Make the tail narrower so that it stays behind the body.
hawk.next: Extend the brown hood down the sides of the face and give the eyes brown irises, as in the mockup.

familiar-owl.summary: The model is a white owl with cyan eyes, a cyan ribbon, and a gold star. The face and the expression match the mockup, but the body is taller and the feather texture is weak.
strengths: The stern cyan eyes and the dark beak match the mockup expression.
The cyan ribbon and the gold star read at 128 px in the front directions.
The walk is readable and the feet stay on the ground.
issues: The body is tall and boxy. Make the body rounder and shorter, and blend the head into the body.
The belly has small, sparse marks. Carve dense teardrop feather marks into the belly and the wings, as in the mockup.
The ear tufts are sharp and show as one horn in the side view and the side sprites. Make the ear tufts softer and lower.
The wings have grey stripes that the mockup does not have. Remove the stripes.
The star sits beside the bow. Hang the star from the bow.
The back of the head shows stacked horizontal ledges. Smooth the back of the head.
familiar-owl.next: Make the body rounder and shorter, and carve dense teardrop feather marks into the belly.

messenger-bird.summary: The model is a cream chick with blush cheeks, a leather strap, and a letter tube. The face and the tube match the mockup, but the body, the wings, and the tube position have clear differences.
strengths: The face with blush cheeks, black eyes, and a grey beak matches the mockup.
The tube with the white letter and the red seal reads at 128 px in most directions.
The strap with the buckle is clean and fits the body.
issues: The wings are narrow plates with a scale texture. The mockup has one large smooth brown wing on each side. Make the wings larger, rounder, and smooth.
The body is tall, with a waist below the head. Make the body shorter and rounder, as in the mockup.
The tube is at the front of the shoulder and covers the cheek in the side view. Move the tube back so that it comes up behind the shoulder.
The legs have cream feather thighs. Show short pink legs below the body.
The tail is a low flat fan near the feet in the back view. Make the tail a long point that goes back from the rump, as in the mockup.
messenger-bird.next: Make the wings large and smooth so that they cover the sides of the body.

chicken.summary: The model is a plump white chicken with a red comb, a red wattle, and yellow feet. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the wings, the legs, and the comb are clearly different.
strengths: The egg-shaped white body and the face match the mockup.
The red comb, the red wattle, and the yellow beak read at 128 px in all front directions.
The walk is readable and the feet stay on the ground.
issues: The wings point out to the sides like arms and have finger-shaped tips. Make the wings thicker and let them hang down along the body, as in the mockup.
The legs are long and thin, and the feet are small. Make the legs shorter and thicker, and make the toes wider.
The comb has three small lobes. Make the comb taller, with a row of points from the front to the back.
The tail is a thin flat plate that shows edge-on from the side. Give the tail volume or make it smaller.
chicken.next: Make the wings thick and let them hang down along the body.

riding-lizard.summary: The model is a green riding lizard with orange stripes, a cream belly, and a brown saddle. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the head is round and the eyes are much larger.
strengths: The palette matches the mockup: soft green skin, orange stripes, a cream belly and jaw, and a brown leather saddle.
The four-leg stance and the head height above the saddle are close to the mockup.
At 128 px, the saddle, the stripes on the tail and the legs, and the happy face read in most directions.
The rig has idle, walk, run, attack, hit, and death clips. The legs and the tail move in the walk, and the feet stay on the ground.
issues: The head is round and the eyes are approximately two times too large. The mockup has a box-shaped snout with two nostrils and small bead eyes. Make the snout longer and flatter, add the nostrils, and make the eyes smaller.
The mouth opens too wide and shows a large pink tongue. The mockup shows a wide grin with a narrow red gap. Close the jaw partially.
The stripes are small, square marks. The mockup has longer, curved bars on the side of the head, the neck, and the back. Make the stripes longer and curve them around the body.
The feet are short and have small white claws. The mockup has spread toes with dark claws. Make the toes longer and make the claws dark.
The saddle has a box shape with flat sides. The mockup saddle is round and has a vertical strap with a buckle. Make the saddle edges round.
The tail is almost straight. The mockup tail curves up at the tip. Curve the end of the tail up.
riding-lizard.next: Change the head: make the snout longer and box-shaped, add the nostrils, and make the eyes smaller.

dragon-mount.summary: The model is a green baby dragon with gold horns, a cream belly, small wings, and a brown saddle. The identity matches the mockup, but the face is noticeably different and a flat cut shows on the back of the head and the neck.
strengths: The gold horns, the small spikes between the horns, and the gold ear fins match the mockup. They read clearly at 128 px.
The brown saddle with a red seat and the gold tail spikes match the mockup.
The large head and the short legs give a chibi shape.
issues: A flat cut shows on the back of the head and the neck. It is a straight vertical edge in the side view and a flat oval in the back view. It also shows in all walk and run frames and in the N, E, and W sprites. Make the back of the head and the neck round.

The face is different from the mockup. The eyes bulge above the head, and the snout hangs down. The mockup has eyes set into the face, a broad round snout with large nostrils, round cheeks, and a wide smile. Set the eyes into the face, lift the snout, and make it broader.

The belly plates are narrow rings with dark gaps between them. The mockup has wide, smooth cream plates from the chin to the belly. Make the plates wider, remove the dark gaps, and continue the plates down the belly.
The wings are small, dark, and narrow. They look like dry leaves and read badly at 128 px. The mockup has larger tan membranes with brown edges. Make the wings larger and use a light tan membrane.

The body sits low, and the hind legs fold under it. The walk and the run move only the front legs. The mockup stands on four legs. Lift the hind part of the body and move all four legs in the walk and the run.
The tail lies on the ground. The mockup tail curves up behind the body. Curve the tail up.
The green is darker and more saturated than the light jade green of the mockup. Make the green lighter.
The model is a mount for the sky games, but it has no fly clip. Add a fly clip with wing strokes.
dragon-mount.next: Make the back of the head and the neck round to remove the flat cut. Then set the eyes into the face and make the snout broad and round.

gryphon-mount.summary: The model is an orange gryphon mount with a yellow beak, raised wings, a braided tail, and a blue saddle. It is the same character as the mockup, but the face frowns and the neck is short and thick.
strengths: The palette matches the mockup: an orange body, a yellow beak, yellow legs with brown toes, and blue gems on the strap.
All signature details are present: the crest, the yellow ear, the raised wings, the braided tail, and the blue saddle.
At 128 px, the beak, the eyes, the wings, and the blue saddle read in the side and three-quarter directions.
The rig has idle, walk, run, fly, roar, attack, hit, and death clips. The feet stay on the ground in the walk.
issues: The face frowns. The brows are low and the corners of the beak turn down. The mockup smiles. Turn the corners of the beak up and raise the inner ends of the brows.
The neck is short and thick because a large ruff of shingle feathers covers it. The mockup has a long, slim neck with smooth feather lines. Make the ruff smaller and make the neck longer and thinner.
A brown seat and a brown bag cover a large part of the blue saddle. The mockup shows only a blue shield-shaped pad with a gold rim and rivets. Remove the bag or make it smaller, and add the gold rim.
The ruff hides the brown breast strap. The mockup shows the strap across the chest. Move the strap down so that it shows below the ruff.
The tail tuft spreads into thin points like fingers. The mockup has a full, soft tuft. Make the tuft thicker and rounder.
The wings stay still in the walk. Add a small wing movement to the walk.
gryphon-mount.next: Change the face to a smile: turn the corners of the beak up and raise the inner ends of the brows.

graveyard-staff.summary: A cream driftwood shepherd's crook with a mint lantern, a bone charm, a moon charm, a purple ribbon, and a leather grip. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The S-curve of the crook, the driftwood knots, and the knot near the bottom match the mockup.
The mint lantern at the crook tip is the focal point. The cream wood, the purple ribbon, and the brown leather match the mockup palette.
The crook, the lantern, and the grip read clearly in six of eight sprite directions.
The avatar holds the staff at the leather grip, the same as the accepted staff.
issues: The crook tip is a round, heavy lump. In the mockup, the tip is a thin hook that turns up and holds the lantern ring. Make the crook head thinner and end it in a hook.
The ribbon is a short purple cuff with a zigzag edge. In the mockup, it is a purple cord wrap with long pointed tails over the leather. Make the tails longer and pointed.
The white charm at the ribbon is a small fang. In the mockup, it is a silver crescent moon. Change it to a silver crescent.

The charms hang on a thick black rod, and a tall black cage surrounds the lantern globe. In the mockup, a thin silver chain holds the charms, and a dark bronze frame with a small top ring holds the globe. Make the rod thin and light, and make the frame smaller.

In the avatar rest pose, the lantern and the charm string point sideways along the shaft. The moon charm comes near the tunic. Angle the string toward the ground in the held pose if the equip rules permit it.
graveyard-staff.next: Make the crook head thinner and end it in an upturned hook that holds the lantern ring, as in the mockup.

echo-staff.summary: A steel-blue tuning-fork staff with a lilac crystal between the tines and two teal rings at one side. It matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: All mockup parts are present: the fork, the lilac crystal, the two teal rings, the collar rings, the thin shaft, and the ball foot.
The lilac crystal is the focal point against the calm steel-blue shaft. The palette matches the mockup.
The crystal and the fork read in all eight sprite directions.
The avatar holds the staff below the fork, the same as the accepted staff.
issues: The fork tines show horizontal ridges. In the mockup, the tines are smooth, polished metal. Make the tine surface smooth.
The tines are tall, thin, and straight. In the mockup, the tines are thicker at the base and curve in at the tips to hold the crystal. Make the tines thicker at the base and curve the tips in.

The crystal is a long six-sided prism with short points and one flat color. In the mockup, the crystal has a longer top point, a lighter top, and a translucent look. Make the top point longer and lighten the top.
The teal rings are flat color. In the mockup, the rings glow. Give the rings an emissive glow.
echo-staff.next: Make the tines smooth and thicker at the base, with tips that curve in to hold the crystal, as in the mockup.

baker.summary: The model is the mockup baker boy with a chef hat, a cream apron, and a bread board in two hands. It is the same character, but the hat, the ears, and the mouth show clear differences, and the rest clip has a chin intersection.
strengths: The palette matches the mockup: a cream hat and apron, a brown shirt, dark brown trousers, cream sock cuffs, and tan shoes.
The hat, the apron, and the bread board make the identity clear in all eight sprite directions. The face reads in the S, SW, and SE sprites.
The bread board stays in the two hands in all eight clips. The cheer hop, the hit recoil, and the attack push read clearly.
The bread reads as bread: one dark bun with seeds and one golden bun on a wood board.
The curly forelock on the hat band, the white wrist cuffs, and the apron straps match the mockup.
issues: The chef hat is too low and has one lumpy puff. The mockup hat is taller than the head and has two or three large pleated lobes. Make the hat about 20 percent taller and shape clear lobes with folds between them.
In the rest clip, the head bends forward and the chin goes into the apron bib. The bib edge cuts the mouth in the three-quarter view. Decrease the head bend, or move the chin in front of the bib.
The mockup has large ears that stand out from the head. The model ears are small, and the side hair hides them in the front view. Make the ears larger and turn them out.
The mouth corners are sharp, and at sprite size the teeth read as fangs. The mockup shows a soft wide grin with two front teeth. Round the mouth corners into a soft U shape.
The model adds dark side hair at the temples and a full hair cap at the back. The mockup shows almost no hair below the hat band. Reduce the side hair so that the ears and the cheeks read.
The mockup shows a wood board or basket on the back. The model back is empty. Add the back item, or record that the design removes it.
The mockup shirt has a white collar above the bib. The model has no collar. Add a small white collar.
The winged eyelashes make the face look older than the mockup boy. Use plain lash lines.
The cast clip and the idle clip show little movement, and they look almost the same. The walk and the run keep the upper body still. Add a body bob and a small tray sway.
baker.next: Make the chef hat taller than the head, with two or three pleated lobes. Also fix the chin intersection in the rest clip, because the defect cap keeps the rating at 7.0 until you fix it.

apothecary.summary: An old apothecary woman with a bun, gold round glasses, a purple dress, and a cream apron. She holds a round bottle low and a flask high. The character is clear, but the hair color, the dress length, and the age cues differ from the mockup.
strengths: The gold round glasses, the bun, and the cream apron match the mockup. They are clear at 128 px.
The pose with one bottle low and one flask high follows the mockup.
The bottles look like glass with colored liquid.
issues: The hair is pale lavender. The mockup hair is mid gray. Change the hair to a neutral gray with darker gray shadows.
The dress is a straight robe that stops at the shoes. The mockup dress is a flared skirt that stops at the knee and shows the legs. Shorten and flare the skirt.
The face looks young. The mockup has bushy gray brows, a large round nose, and small wrinkle lines. Add these age cues.
The round bottle is small and at the waist. The mockup holds a large bottle at chest height. Make the bottle larger and raise the hand.
The plume on the raised flask looks like a bone with knobs. Make it a soft, curling plume of smoke.
The dress is a saturated plum color. The mockup dress is a muted mauve. Decrease the saturation.
The apron has three colored vials in one pocket. The mockup has two pockets with one green-capped vial each. This difference is small.
apothecary.next: Change the hair to gray and make the skirt a flared, knee-length skirt that shows the legs.

armorer.summary: A bearded armorer with chain mail sleeves, a leather tabard, a round shield, and a hammer. The outfit matches, but the hair, the belt, and the hammer size are clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The chain mail sleeves have a clear metal texture.
The round shield has a wood face, a silver rim, rivets, and a boss, as in the mockup.
The open smile in the full beard matches the mockup expression.
issues: The hair is a smooth, round cap that looks like a fur hat or a helmet. The mockup has thick, curly locks with volume on top. Model separate curly locks.
The eye size is the house style, but the long, curved upper lashes give the broad, bearded man a feminine look. Remove the lashes or make them short.
The wide leather belt with the square silver buckle and the side pouches is missing. Add the belt at the waist.
The hammer is small. In the front view its head points at the viewer. The mockup hammer has a large silver head that is held out to the side. Make the head larger and show its profile.
The shield is smaller than in the mockup. Make it larger so that it covers the side of the body.
The face has no visible nose. The mockup has a large round nose. Add a nose.
The trousers are brown. The mockup trousers are dark olive gray with leather cuffs on the boots.
armorer.next: Replace the cap of hair with curly locks and add the wide belt with the silver buckle.

brewer.summary: A ginger brewer in a brown flat cap with a hop cone, who holds a small keg in both hands. The props and the colors match, but the chubby face and the suspenders of the mockup are lost.
strengths: The flat cap with the hop cone, the ginger hair, and the keg give a clear brewer identity.
The keg is in both hands at the waist, as in the mockup.
The open smile matches the mockup expression.
issues: The face is the slim base face. The mockup face is round and chubby, with a large round nose, strong red cheeks, and large ears. Make the face rounder and add the nose and the cheeks.
The torso has a brown vest. The mockup has brown suspenders with metal buttons over a cream shirt. Replace the vest with suspenders.
The hop cone on the cap is a smooth green lump. Model it as a cone of overlapping scales with small leaves.
The body is slim. The mockup body is short and wide. Make the torso wider and rounder.
The trousers are brown. The mockup shorts are khaki. Change the trouser color.
The keg wood is light orange with dark hoops. The mockup keg is darker brown with silver hoops.
The hands touch the ends of the keg but do not grip it as in the mockup.
brewer.next: Rebuild the face as a round, chubby face with a large nose and strong red cheeks.

carpenter.summary: A young carpenter with a red headband, a blue shirt, tan overalls, and a tool belt, who holds a handsaw. The outfit matches the mockup well, but the saw hangs down and the mockup holds it up.
strengths: The red headband, the blue shirt, the tan overalls, and the brown straps match the mockup palette.
The tool belt with the hammer, the yellow ruler, and the pouch puts detail at the waist.
The closed smile matches the mockup expression.
issues: The saw hangs down at the side with the tip near the ground. In the mockup the hand holds the saw up and forward at approximately 30 degrees. Raise the saw to the mockup angle.
In the walk clip the saw tip comes down to the ground line. Keep the saw clear of the ground.
The hair is one smooth swept shape. The mockup hair has separate, tousled locks. Add separate locks on top.
The yellow pencil in the headband is missing. Add it. The headband tails are at the back, and in the mockup they hang at the side of the head.
In the front view the saw blade is a thin gray strip. Make the blade wider so that it is clear at 128 px.
carpenter.next: Raise the saw to the mockup angle, up and forward from the hand.

cobbler.summary: An old bald cobbler with white side hair, a white mustache, and a brown apron, who holds up a shoe and a hammer. The pose and the palette match, but the shoe is not clear and the model adds glasses.
strengths: The bald head, the white side hair, the bushy white brows, and the mustache match the mockup.
Both arms are up and show the shoe and the hammer, as in the mockup.
The brown apron with brass buttons over the cream shirt matches the mockup palette.
issues: The shoe is a red half disc with a dark sole. It does not look like a shoe. Model a toe, a heel, a sole, and laces, as in the mockup.
The model wears round glasses. The mockup has no glasses. Remove the glasses.
The mouth is a small, round, open shape under the mustache, and it looks surprised. The mockup shows a smile. Change the mouth to a smile.
The nose is small. The mockup has a large round nose. Make the nose larger.
The side hair is a white tuft. The mockup side hair is a curl in a spiral. Add the curl.
The trousers are short and dark green. The mockup trousers are wide and olive. The quilted apron texture is also different from the smooth leather in the mockup.
cobbler.next: Rebuild the red shoe with a clear toe, heel, sole, and laces.

cook.summary: A young cook in a white chef hat and jacket, who holds a copper pot and raises a wooden spoon. The identity is clear, but the bow tie, the hair, and the low pot are different from the mockup.
strengths: The white hat, the white jacket, and the white apron with a red accent at the neck give a clear cook identity.
The copper pot with handles and the raised wooden spoon match the mockup props.
The closed smile with red lips matches the mockup expression.
issues: The pot hangs low at the knee. In the mockup the pot is at the waist against the hip. Raise the pot to the waist.
The neck has a red bow tie. The mockup has a red neckerchief with loose ends. Replace the bow tie with a neckerchief.
The hair is a short, smooth bob. The mockup hair is wavy and falls in curls to the shoulders. Add wavy locks below the hat.
The steam is a thick gray tube that looks like a bent pipe. Make it thin and translucent, or remove it.
A dark line shows between the hat brim and the hair in the front and three-quarter views. Close the gap or make the brim white.
The jacket buttons are gold, and the mockup buttons are white. The trousers are almost black, and the mockup trousers are gray.
cook.next: Raise the pot to the waist against the hip, as in the mockup.

fisher.summary: A young fisher in a yellow rain hat, a yellow coat, and green boots, who holds a fish and a fishing rod. The silhouette and the palette match, but the bulky navy scarf of the mockup is missing.
strengths: The yellow hat, the yellow coat, and the green boots give a strong silhouette in all eight sprite directions.
The fish and the rod with a line and a float are clear.
The closed smile matches the mockup expression.
issues: The bulky navy knit scarf at the neck is missing. Only a small navy V shows. Add a thick, ribbed navy scarf around the neck.
Little hair shows below the hat. The mockup shows thick, tousled black hair at the front and the sides. Add hair volume below the brim.
The coat has brown toggle buttons. The mockup coat has round silver buttons. Change the buttons.
The fish is small and at the waist. The mockup holds the fish at chest height. Make the fish larger and raise it.
The rod is light brown with a reel and a red float. The mockup rod is a dark brown stick with a white tip. This difference is small.
fisher.next: Add the thick navy knit scarf around the neck.

gardener.summary: An old gardener with a white beard, a wide hat, a yellow shirt, and green overalls, who holds a watering can. The outfit is close, but the stern face and the small can are different from the mockup.
strengths: The white beard and the wide hat with a green band give a clear silhouette in all views.
The yellow shirt and the green overalls follow the mockup palette.
In the walk clip the can moves with the arm.
issues: The white brows slope down to the center, so the face looks stern. The mockup face is cheerful, with raised brows and a smile. Raise the brows and show a smiling mouth.
The nose is small. The mockup has a large, red, round nose and red cheeks. Add the large nose.
The watering can is small and hangs at the feet. In the front view it is a small green block. Make the can larger and hold it at the hip with the spout to the side.
The hat is straw yellow with a round crown. The mockup hat is tan felt with a pinched crown. Change the hat color and shape.
The plaid on the shirt is faint. Add dark plaid lines.
The overalls are bright green with a quilted texture. The mockup overalls are smooth olive green.
The metal tool that hangs at the side in the mockup is missing.
gardener.next: Change the face to a cheerful face: raise the brows, add a smile, and add the large red nose.

bartender.summary: A mustached bartender with a foamy mug, a green vest, and a cream apron. The costume matches the mockup, but the hair and the face are clearly different.
strengths: The cream shirt, the green vest with gold buttons, the cream apron, and the brown boots match the mockup.
The wooden mug has gold bands and white foam. The mug reads in every sprite direction.
The extended mug arm gives a clear front and three-quarter silhouette.
issues: The hair is a lumpy cap with a swoop on top and locks that hang over the forehead. It reads as a hat. Change it to the swept, wavy pompadour of the mockup.
The hair is a medium chestnut. Make it the very dark brown of the mockup.
The mustache is a thin handlebar line, and it hides the mouth. Make the mustache thick and bushy, and show the closed smile under it.
The mug is at chest height and the hand holds the handle. Raise the mug to shoulder height and hold it by the body, as in the mockup.
The towel on the shoulder is a narrow strap. Make it a folded cloth that hangs over the shoulder.
The vest is a bright green. Make it the dark olive of the mockup.
The eye line continues onto the temple. In the side view it reads as a glasses arm.
bartender.next: Rebuild the hair as a dark, swept pompadour and show the smile under a bushy mustache.

merchant.summary: A bearded merchant with a maroon hat, an orange sash, and a coin pouch. The face matches the mockup, but a skin gap between the hat and the hair is a visible defect.
strengths: The large black beard, the thick eyebrows, and the open smiling mouth match the mockup.
The coin pouch has gold coins and gold ties, and it reads at 128 px.
The maroon hat, the orange sash, and the cream sleeves give a clear color plan.
issues: A strip of skin shows between the hat and the hair in the side and back views. Close the gap so that the hair meets the hat.
The hair on the side of the head is a black stripe across the temple, and the back hair has two lumps at the bottom. Make the side hair a short, even sideburn and smooth the back.
The hat is a tall, round puff. Make it a flatter, slouched beret that tilts to one side, as in the mockup.
The coat is a long skirt that hides the legs. Shorten it so that the brown trousers and the boot cuffs show.
The pouch is low at the hip. Extend the arm forward and hold the pouch at chest height.
The coat is a pale mint. Make it the darker sage green of the mockup and add the gold trim along the open front.
The sash is a smooth band. Add the knot and the hanging tails.
merchant.next: Close the skin gap between the hat and the hair.

mayor.summary: A mayor with a top hat, a big pink nose, a gold chain, and a scroll. He is clearly the mockup character, but the coat and the pose have clear differences.
strengths: The black top hat with the red band, the large pink nose, and the grey eyebrows and side hair match the mockup.
The gold chain with a medallion, the white jabot, and the scroll with a red ribbon are all present.
The burgundy coat with the high collar and the white cuffs reads in every sprite direction.
issues: The coat is closed and long, like a robe. Open the coat front to show the cream waistcoat, the gold buttons, and the dark grey trousers.
The right arm hangs at the side. Raise the right hand to the side with an open palm, as in the mockup.
The mustache is thin and very pale. Make it thicker, grey, and curled at the ends.
The smile is small. Make the mouth a wide smile with visible teeth.
The ears are small. Make them large, as in the mockup.
The grey hair has a lavender tint. Use a neutral grey.
mayor.next: Open the coat front to show the cream waistcoat and the dark trousers.

town-crier.summary: A town crier in a blue coat and a blue tricorn who shouts with a raised bell. The colors and the face match, but the hat shape and the bell are clearly different.
strengths: The open shouting mouth and the green eyes match the mockup.
The blue coat with gold trim, the gold buttons, the cream shirt, and the black belt with a gold buckle match the mockup.
The tricorn and the raised arm read well in the 128 px sprites.
issues: The tricorn is a flat, boxy tray with straight vertical panels. Make the brim curve up softly into three rounded corners, as in the mockup.
The hat brim and the gold trim show faceted shading streaks. Smooth the brim mesh.
The bell is a trumpet shape and reads as a horn. Make it a domed handbell with a short top handle.
The coat is closed to the knee and hides the legs. Open the lower coat to show the cream breeches and the white stockings.
The brown fringe does not show under the hat. Add the hair locks at the forehead and the sides.
The scroll is a flat sheet with lines. Make it a rolled parchment.
town-crier.next: Rebuild the tricorn with a soft, curved, upturned brim.

herbalist.summary: A young herbalist with a green headscarf, a braid, a laced green dress, and a basket of flowers. She matches the mockup well, but the basket pose and the headscarf are clearly different.
strengths: The soft smile, the rosy cheeks, and the brown braid over the right shoulder match the mockup.
The green scarf, the laced brown bodice panel, the satchel, and the boots are all present.
The palette matches the mockup.
issues: The basket hangs low at the side in one hand. Hold the basket in front of the body with both hands, as in the mockup.
The headscarf is a hard, smooth dome. Add soft cloth folds and let it sit lower at the back of the head.
The hair shows only as a band across the forehead. Add the long side locks that frame the face.
The headscarf, the scarf, and the dress have one green value. From the back the sprites read as one green mass. Make the headscarf and the scarf darker than the dress.
The basket has few leaves. Add more green leaves above the rim.
The hair edge at the temple has a stepped cut in the side view.
herbalist.next: Hold the basket in front of the body with both hands.

weaponsmith.summary: A red-haired weaponsmith with a leather apron, big gloves, and a raised sword. The character reads well, but the sword is clearly different from the mockup.
strengths: The spiky flame-red hair, the thick red eyebrows, and the smile match the mockup.
The grey shirt, the riveted leather apron, the belt, the large gloves, and the boots match the mockup.
The character reads clearly in all eight 128 px sprite directions.
issues: The sword blade is a thin rod with a small gold crossguard. Make it a broad longsword with a fuller and a heavy silver crossguard with round ends.
The sword hand is at shoulder height. Lower the hand to waist height and keep the blade upright, as in the mockup.
The hair spikes are only on top, and the sides and back are a smooth cap. Add spikes and locks at the sides and the back.
The ears are small. Make them large, as in the mockup.
The apron rivets are brass. Make them silver.
A hammer hangs at the belt. The mockup shows silver tongs on the belt.
weaponsmith.next: Replace the thin blade with a broad longsword that has a heavy silver crossguard.
